description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hypnotic Siren, adding {U}.
When Hypnotic Siren dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hypnotic Siren on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Hypnotic Siren from your library.
Cast Hypnotic Siren by paying {U}.
Repeat.
